content: Thuku Pualak
Hisia thu hu in keima Paul sia no Gentile te atu, Jesus Christ min taw thongtak pa ka hihi,
Note kungah Pathian thuthiamna a keamcing tu nasep sia keima tungah hong pia hi, ci thu na za zo uh ahile:
Nidang in tawmno ka at sa bangma in, hong kilaak na tungtawn in thuku sia ka tungah hong he sak hi,
Tua ka at thu na sim uh ciang in Christ i thuku ka heakna sia note in na telthiam tu uh hi,
Tua thuku sia tu in Ama sawltak te le kamsang thiangtho te tungah Thaa tungtawn in a kilang bang in, hun tatuam sungah mihing te tungah he sak ngei ngawl hi;
Tabang in Gentile mite sia lungdamna thupha tungtawn in ngamhlua te le pumpi khat sungah pumkhat suak tu in Christ sungah Ama kamciam a sang khawm te a hi thei natu a hihi:
Ama i a vanglian nasepna tungtawn in ka tungah hongpiak Pathian thuthiamna letsong bang in, hi lungdamna thupha naseam tu in hong vawt hi.
A kikan zo ngawl Christ i hauna thu sia Gentile mite sungah ka hil thei natu in, mithiangtho theampo sungah a nobel sang in a no zaw keima tungah hi thuthiamna hong pia hi;
Jesus Christ tungtawn in na theampo a bitphua Pathian sungah, leitung piancil pan kipan a phualseal ki pawlkhopna thuku sia mi theampo tungah hong musak tu hi:
Tu in vantung ah thuneina te le vangletna te sia pawlpi in Pathian pilna tampi a heak thei natu ngealna a hihi,
Tua thu sia tawntung ngealna bangma in i Topa Christ Jesus sungah ngealna hi a:
Tua i Topa Christ Jesus sungah Ama i upna tungtawn in hangsan le kimuanna taw tum thei na i nei hi.
Tua ahikom note atu in ka haksatna sungah na thaneam ngawl tu uh ka dei hi, banghangziam cile hi haksatna sia note vangletna a hihi.
Paul in Ephesus Pawlpi atu Thungen
Hi thu hang in i Topa Jesus Christ i Pa tungah ka khupdin a,
Vantung le leitung a om innkuan buppi sia minphuasa a hihi,
Tabang in Ama minthanna hauna bang in A Thaa thahatna taw note i sungsang mihing tha hong dim tu in ahizong;
Na thinsung uh ah Christ sia na upna uh tungtawn in om tu a; itna sungah zungtha le zungkip in na om thei natu uh ahizong,
Mi thiangtho te taw Christ itna a zaina, a sauna, a thukna le a sanna, na heak thei natu uh ahizong;
Tua Christ itna sia heakna sang in sangzaw a, Pathian kicinna taw na theampo na kidim thei natu uh ahizong, thu kong ngetsak hi.
Tu in kote sungah naseam pa vangletna bang in, i ngetna ahibale, i ngaisutna theampo i tungah a dimlet in na a seam thei pa tung ah,
Pawlpi sung le Christ Jesus tungtawn in hun theampo sungah tawp ni nei ngawl leitung dong in minthang tahen. Amen.
